2609.05782.title: Distilling Vision-Language Models for On-Device Fire Understanding
2609.05782.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative to conventional fire detection systems by reasoning about the semantic context of a scene and thus reducing false alarms, yet their large model size makes deployment on embedded fire sensors impractical. In this paper, we study how domain-specialized VLMs can be compressed for fully on-device deployment without losing the safety-critical behavior required for fire detection. We develop a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework in which large VLMs fine-tuned for fire understanding can be distilled into lightweight students. Experiments across multiple VLM families and model scales show that compact students preserve most of their teachers' fire-understanding capability. We further deploy the distilled models on our commercial Detectium fire detection sensor and jointly evaluate reasoning accuracy, latency, and memory usage. The results show that compression and deployment affect not only accuracy but also model failure modes, with Qwen2.5-0.5B providing the strongest overall deployment trade-off. Our findings provide broader guidance for deploying domain-specialized VLMs in resource-constrained, safety-critical settings.
2609.05782.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLMs）通過推理場景的語義上下文，提供了傳統火災檢測系統的一個有前途的替代方案，從而減少誤報，然而它們龐大的模型大小使得在嵌入式火災傳感器上的部署變得不切實際。<lb/>在本文中，我們研究了如何壓縮專門針對特定領域的 VLMs，以便在不失去火災檢測所需的安全關鍵行為的情況下實現完全的設備內部署。<lb/>我們開發了一個教師-學生知識蒸餾框架，其中針對火災理解進行微調的大型 VLMs 可以被蒸餾成輕量級的學生模型。<lb/>在多個 VLM 家族和模型規模上的實驗顯示，緊湊的學生模型保留了大部分教師模型的火災理解能力。<lb/>我們進一步將蒸餾後的模型部署在我們的商業 Detectium 火災檢測傳感器上，並共同評估推理準確性、延遲和內存使用情況。<lb/>結果顯示，壓縮和部署不僅影響準確性，還影響模型的失效模式，其中 Qwen2.5-0.5B 提供了最強的整體部署權衡。<lb/>我們的研究結果為在資源受限和安全關鍵的環境中部署專門針對特定領域的 VLMs 提供了更廣泛的指導。
